newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Crown's new debt facility worth A$650 mln.
newsitem.headline: Crown's new debt facility worth A$650 mln.

text.p: Australian casino company Crown Ltd has a new seven-year debt package worth A$650 million, the underwriting bankers said on Thursday.
Australia and New Zealand Banking Group has underwritten A$400 million of the debt and Bank of America the rest, the two banks said in a joint statement.
Crown announced on Wednesday it had completed a refinancing of its secured borrowings, but did not give details.
ANZ said on Thursday it would also provide a A$50 million leveraged lease facility and A$30 million in working capital, becoming Crown's primary local bank.
Bank of America would provide a A$25 million term letter of credit, the statement said.
The refinancing follows the opening this year of Crown's new casino and entertainment complex in Melbourne. The project has been costed by some analysts at over A$2 billion.
During construction, Crown was relying on project finance.
